actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Case step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode): Type Case__c drives the stamped status and lookup fields, and FlowApiName_Case__c is the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Case_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert Case

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the File Uploads step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode). Its rule inspects the five File Upload JSON fields for entries still marked processed:false, so files relink exactly once no matter how many passes run; FlowApiName_FileUpload__c is the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Files_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert Files

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Lead 1 step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode): EventName Lead routes Setup to Lead matching settings, Type Lead_1__c drives the stamped fields, FlowApiName_Lead1__c is the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Lead_1_Platform_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert Lead 1

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Lead 2 (alternate lead) step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode); Type carries Lead_2__c and FlowApiName_Lead2__c is the override hook. Requires Contact2 Last Name to be populated, since alternate person fields share that entry gate.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Lead_2_Platform_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert Lead 2

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Opportunity step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode); FlowApiName_Opportunity__c is the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Opportunity_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert Opportunity

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Account step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode): EventName Account routes Setup to the template's Account matching settings, Type Account__c tells the Log action which status and lookup fields to stamp, and FlowApiName comes from FlowApiName_Account__c, which is the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_Organization
actionCalls.label: Convert Organization

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Contact 1 step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode): EventName Contact routes Setup to Contact matching settings, Type Contact_1__c drives which status field and lookup the Log action stamps, and FlowApiName comes from FlowApiName_Contact1__c, the override hook.
actionCalls.name: Convert_PersonAccount_1_Platform_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert PersonAccount (1)

actionCalls.description: Dispatches the Contact 2 (alternate contact) step's step via the Log Conversion Event action (Convert to Record mode). Identical mechanics to Contact 1 except Type carries Contact_2__c; FlowApiName_Contact2__c is the override hook. Only fires when Contact2 Last Name is populated.
actionCalls.name: Convert_PersonAccount_2_Platform_Event
actionCalls.label: Convert PersonAccount (2)

actionCalls.description: Finish logging for the template-level bypass path (Conversion Type Bypass or blank). Statuses go Ready to Bypassed and the submission is marked Complete without any records being converted, so reporting can distinguish bypassed submissions from converted ones.
actionCalls.name: Log_Bypassed
actionCalls.label: Log (Bypassed)

actionCalls.description: The default outcome: every enabled rule reports done. Logs a Finish event through the Log Conversion Event action, which re-reads the current status fields in bulk, flips any still Ready to Bypassed, and marks the overall Conversion Status Complete. Complete is terminal: Switch Start breaks on it, so the pipeline cannot run twice without a new Start event.
actionCalls.name: Log_Conversion_Complete
actionCalls.label: Log (Conversion Complete)

assignments.description: Retags the in-memory event as EventName Email, Type Confirmation before the send. The Log Conversion Event action keys its log entry and status handling off these values, so the email attempt is logged under its own event type instead of the rule that happened to precede it.
assignments.name: Reset_Event
assignments.label: Reset Event

decisions.description: The heart of the pipeline. Rules evaluate top to bottom and the FIRST match wins, calling the action (which publishes one event) and ending the pass: Account, Contact 1, Lead 1, Contact 2, Lead 2, Opportunity, Case, then Additional Data, Related Records, Files, and Confirmation, with the default outcome logging Finish when nothing remains. A rule matches while the template's Conversion Rules setting enables it AND its status field is not yet Created, Matched, or Updated (a blank target lookup also qualifies). When adding a custom rule in a clone, follow the same pattern: gate on your own status field so your rule is idempotent, publish one event, and end the pass.
decisions.name: Conversion_Rules
decisions.label: Switch

rules.name: Convert_Organization_Household
rules.conditionLogic: (1 OR (3 AND 4 AND 5)) AND 2 AND (NOT(6) OR 7 OR NOT(8))
rules.label: 🏢 Convert Organization/Household

rules.name: Convert_PersonAccount_2
rules.conditionLogic: (1 OR (3 AND 4 AND 5)) AND 2 AND 6 AND 7
rules.label: 🙋‍♂️ Convert PersonAccount(2)

rules.name: Convert_Files
rules.conditionLogic: (1 AND 2) OR (3 AND 4) OR (5 AND 6) OR (7 AND 8) OR (9 AND 10)
rules.label: 🖹 Convert File(s)

decisions.description: Re-fire protection and template gating. Break ends the pass when the submission is missing or already Complete, which makes stray or replayed events harmless. The Bypass outcomes cover templates whose Conversion Type is Bypass or blank: no records convert, but a Bypass with Additional Data still deserializes the related rows first so they exist for reporting, and both paths log a Finish so the submission still reaches Complete.
decisions.name: Switch_Start
decisions.label: Switch

Flow.description:
WHAT IT DOES: The traffic controller of an NPC form conversion. Each time a Form Submission needs converting, this flow looks at the template's Conversion Rules, picks the ONE rule that should run next, sends it off, and ends. The rule's own flow returns a platform event that starts this controller again for the next rule, until nothing is left and the submission is marked Complete. Installed by pointing the Controller record of Form Template Conversion Mapping Default at it.
HOW IT WORKS, STEP BY STEP: 1. The Setup subflow loads the submission, its template and (for repeater rows) the capturing section, and handles the Start reset that makes Reprocess possible. 2. One decision - Conversion Rules - walks the rules in priority order and dispatches the first whose work is not finished. A rule is finished when its lookup on the submission is filled and its status reads Created, Matched or Updated; an Error or Ready status means "run me again", which is exactly how Reprocess and multi-pass conversions work. 3. The one NPC difference from the packaged controller: in Household mode (the template includes Account is Household, or names a Household record type), the ACCOUNT rule politely waits until Contact 1 exists. So Contact 1 converts first and looks for the family's existing Household; if there is none, the Account rule then creates one, and Contact 1 comes through once more to join it. Without Household mode, or on a template that never converts Contact 1, the packaged order stands: Account before people, because a business Add to Account needs the Account to exist first. 4. Every dispatch is a Log Conversion Event action in Convert to Record mode: it publishes the platform event carrying which flow to run and which status and lookup fields that flow's logs should stamp. The FlowApiName fields on the template are override hooks - name a custom flow there and it runs instead of the default. 5. When no rule matches, Finish logs, stamps anything unprocessed as Bypassed, and the conversion is Complete.
WHERE IT FITS: This is the same one-rule-per-pass state machine as the packaged controller, so everything an admin knows about the Form Template framework - conversion statuses on the submission, the Conversion Log, Reprocess, per-template flow overrides - applies unchanged. Only the Household-mode ordering is NPC-specific.

formulas.description: True when this template builds a Household: the Account is Household rule is on, or the Account record type names a Household type. Drives the hold-back on the Account rule.
formulas.name: HouseholdMode

Flow.label: (NPC) Convert | Process | Form Submission | Overridable

subflows.description: Rebuilds related record rows from the submission's serialized Additional Data JSON (captured at save time), then publishes a fresh Convert event and ends this pass. The re-publish is deliberate: the rebuild performs DML, and re-entering in a clean transaction gives the Related Records work its own governor limits and lets Setup reload the rows it just created.
subflows.name: Deserialize_Additional_Data
subflows.label: Deserialize Additional Data

subflows.description: Converts each captured repeater and table row in order. Each row dispatches through the Convert to Record action to the flow its section resolves (packaged default or Conversion Map Flow override), so every row runs in its own transaction.
subflows.name: Process_Related_Records
subflows.label: Process Related Records

subflows.description: Sends the confirmation exactly once per submission: the rule requires Send Confirmation enabled, a template name configured, Internal Confirmation Last Sent still empty, and a converted Contact 1 or Lead 1 to render the template against.
subflows.name: Send_Confirmation_Email
subflows.label: Send Confirmation Email

subflows.description: The shared front door. Loads the submission, template, parent, related rows, and rule-bearing page sections from the event, and resolves matching-rule settings by EventName. On Start events it logs Conversion Started, which resets every conversion status field to Ready (including custom status fields, discovered as picklists sharing the packaged status value set) and sets the overall status to In Progress, then clears Start__c so later passes never re-reset.
subflows.name: Setup
subflows.label: Setup

variables.description: The template's page sections whose Conversion Rule is set and not Bypass, in page and sort order. Passed to the Related Records step so each captured row converts according to the section that captured it.
variables.name: AllPageSections

variables.description: Debug affordance: supply a Form Submission here to run the controller directly in Flow Builder. Setup fabricates the platform event from it (recordId plus the Debug EventName and Type inputs), so you can step through a pass without publishing anything.
variables.name: DebugRecord

variables.description: The submission being converted, loaded by Setup with every field the rules read.
variables.name: FormSubmission

variables.description: The template whose Conversion Rules decide what happens and in which order.
variables.name: FormTemplate

variables.description: The event that launched this pass. On the first pass Start__c is true (Setup logs Conversion Started and resets every status field); on re-entry passes EventName is Convert with no Start flag. Your clone must stay an active autolaunched flow and keep a Form_Submission_Convert__e input variable: the dispatcher trigger validates both before launching and logs a conversion error if either is missing.
variables.name: PlatformEvent

variables.description: Related record rows (repeater and table section captures) still needing conversion, loaded by Setup only on Convert re-entry passes. Non-empty triggers the Convert Related Records outcome after the primary rules settle; each row is matched to its page section, whose per-section conversion rule and matching settings apply.
variables.name: RelatedRecords
